label: TP
reason: User input from request.getParameter() flows directly into HTML rendering via response.getWriter().println() without full HTML entity encoding. The replace("\"", """) only escapes double quotes, leaving angle brackets (<>, >), ampersands (&), and single quotes unescaped. Attackers can bypass this via single-quote-based payloads, Unicode entities, or non-breaking characters.

evidence.note: User input flows unsanitized to HTML output
